Round113D.constructed_lift_correction.{u_1} {H : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
  [CompleteSpace H] (F G : Submodule ℂ H) (hdense : ∀ g ∈ G, g ∈ closure ↑(F ⊓ G)) (p u0 : ℕ → H)
  (hu0 : ∀ (i : ℕ), u0 i ∈ F) (hcoset : ∀ (i : ℕ), u0 i - p i ∈ G) (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (eta : ℕ → H →L[ℂ] ℂ) (ε : ℝ)
  (hε : 0 < ε) :
  ∃ u R,
    (∀ (i : ℕ), u i ∈ F ∧ u i - p i ∈ G) ∧
      (Summable fun i => ‖A (u i - p i)‖ * ‖eta i‖) ∧
        ∑' (i : ℕ), ‖A (u i - p i)‖ * ‖eta i‖ ≤ 2 * ε * ‖A‖ ∧
          HasSum (fun i => (eta i).smulRight (A (u i - p i))) R ∧
            ‖R‖ ≤ 2 * ε * ‖A‖ ∧
              ∀ (M : H →L[ℂ] H),

                    ∑' (i : ℕ), ‖M (A (u i - p i))‖ * ‖eta i‖ ≤ 2 * ε * ‖A‖ ∧
                      HasSum (fun i => (eta i).smulRight (M (A (u i - p i)))) (M.comp R)
